transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too, and, um, thank you so much for taking the time to see me. I really appreciate it. 

I guess... well, I've been having a bit of a hard time at work lately. I'm a buyer, and... I hope this doesn't sound completely crazy, I really don't want to come across like a problem employee or anything, but... I just can't shake this feeling that some of the people at work, and maybe even some of our vendors, are tracking my buys. Like they're purposely messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. 

My supervisor actually sat down and showed me the reports, and he says they don't prove any of that is happening... so I know I should probably just believe him and drop it. But I just can't stop feeling like it's real, no matter how hard I try to ignore it. Is it okay that I came in for that? I just really want to get back to doing a good job and not stress everyone out, you know? Does that make sense?
Aside from the feeling that people are tracking your work, have you been hearing any sounds or voices that other people don't seem to hear?

Um... well... I guess I have been, a little bit. I mean, it's probably just from being so overworked and tired, honestly. I really don't want you to think I'm completely losing it or anything. 

But... sometimes, like when I'm in the stockroom, or if I'm driving back from a vendor meeting... I'll hear this man's voice. It sounds like he's right behind me. He'll say things like, "Move faster, Scott," or he'll just kind of laugh at my picks. And, um, when I turn around to see who's standing there, nobody is around. 

I know that sounds really weird, doesn't it? I usually just try to ignore it and keep doing my job so I don't cause any issues. Is... is that something that happens when people get really stressed out? I hope it's okay that I told you that, I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
How long have you been experiencing these feelings about your coworkers and hearing this voice?

Well, um... I guess it's been going on for a little while. I mean, not forever, but... maybe around ten months? Roughly? 

I really tried to just push through it, you know? I thought if I just worked harder and kept my head down, it would all just sort of fade away. I didn't want to make a big deal out of nothing or bother anyone with it. Ten months probably sounds like a long time to let something like this go, doesn't it? I'm sorry if I should have come in sooner... I just really wanted to handle it on my own and be a good employee. Is ten months... is that a really bad sign?
During these past ten months, have you experienced any distinct periods where your mood was exceptionally elevated, or alternatively, so low that you struggled to function in your daily life?

Um... well... I guess there have been a few times like that. I mean, I really try to keep everything steady, you know? I don't want to be one of those people who's all over the place. 

But... sometimes, I get these stretches where I just feel... amazing. Like, really, really good. Almost like the whole city is just opening up for me, and I have all this energy to get things done. It feels great at first, honestly. But then... if someone at work questions a purchase order, or if my supervisor tells me I need to slow down... I just... I snap. Way harder than I mean to. 

I always feel so terrible about it afterward. I really don't want to be a difficult person to work with, and I hate getting irritable like that. It's just... in those moments, I feel so dialed in, and it's frustrating when people don't see it. Does that make sense? Is it normal to get a little too intense when you're just trying to do a really good job? I hope I'm not making myself sound like a horrible person...

Looking back over those ten months, would you say that these periods of feeling amazing and irritable happened at the same time you were dealing with the voices and the feeling that people were tracking you, or did those moods happen mostly at different times?

Um... well... I think they kind of overlapped, actually. I mean, I really hope I'm explaining this right, but... yeah. 

Like, there was this one stretch—maybe a few weeks—where I was just feeling so on top of things. I barely needed any sleep, and I was talking to everyone nonstop about the new sneaker trends coming in, and I just felt... untouchable, you know? Like I was doing the best work of my life. But... at that exact same time, I was also really convinced that the vendors were manipulating our numbers behind my back. And... that was also when I was hearing that voice the most, telling me to move faster. 

So, I guess they were happening together. Is... is that okay? I mean, I know it sounds like a lot, and I really don't want you to think I was just totally out of control. I was still showing up to work every day and trying my best! Does it make it worse that they happened at the same time? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information...
